risk_categories.name: Off-Platform Communication/Payment
risk_categories.description: Client asks to move the PRIMARY work discussion or PAYMENT outside the freelancing platform to a personal channel. NOTE: A company's own website, official careers page, or official HR phone number is NOT off-platform — these are standard for legitimate employers. Only flag when the primary contract, work communication, or payment moves to a personal channel.
examples: Let's do payment via direct bank transfer
WhatsApp me to discuss the work
DM me on Instagram to start
risk_categories.recommended_action: Keep all communication and payment on the platform.

risk_categories.name: Unpaid / Free Work Request
risk_categories.description: Client asks for sample work or a full project before hiring without payment.
examples: Complete this test project for free
Do a sample first, we'll pay if selected
risk_categories.recommended_action: Do not begin unpaid work. Request a paid trial or contract first.

risk_categories.name: Upfront Payment Requested From Freelancer
risk_categories.description: Client asks the freelancer to pay a fee, deposit, or training cost before starting.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Never pay a client. Legitimate clients do not charge freelancers.

risk_categories.name: Sensitive Information Request
risk_categories.description: Client asks for personal or financial information before hiring.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Do not share personal or financial information with unverified clients.

risk_categories.name: Suspicious External Links
risk_categories.description: Client shares shortened URLs (bit.ly, tinyurl), unverified or unknown domains, or links that request credentials or claim to 'verify' an account. NOTE: A company's OWN website or official careers page URL is NOT suspicious — this is normal. Only flag shortened, obfuscated, or credential-requesting links.
examples: Click this link to verify your account: bit.ly/xyz
Register at this URL to unlock the job
Login here to confirm your identity
risk_categories.recommended_action: Do not click unknown links. Verify the domain first.

risk_categories.name: Unrealistic Promises
risk_categories.description: Offer promises extremely high pay for very little work or no experience.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Be skeptical of offers that are too good to be true.

risk_categories.name: Excessive Urgency / Pressure
risk_categories.description: Client pressures you to act fast, often to bypass your normal checks.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Slow down. Legitimate clients allow reasonable time to decide.

risk_categories.name: Vague or Suspicious Job Requirements
risk_categories.description: Job description lacks clear scope, deliverables, or payment terms.
examples: Do some tasks, we'll discuss pay later
risk_categories.recommended_action: Ask for a clear scope of work and payment terms in writing.

risk_categories.name: Discriminatory or Restrictive Requirements
risk_categories.description: Job imposes restrictions based on nationality, accent, citizenship, or other protected characteristics.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Consider reporting. Such restrictions often violate platform policies.

risk_categories.name: Suspicious Experience Preference
risk_categories.description: Job specifies age-adjacent or cohort-based preferences that may indicate bias.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Proceed, but be aware of potential age bias.

risk_categories.name: Toxic Work Culture Signals
risk_categories.description: Job description uses aggressive, exploitative, or unhealthy language about team culture.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Proceed with caution. Such language often predicts poor working conditions.

risk_categories.name: Unrealistic Availability Expectations
risk_categories.description: Job demands availability that is unsustainable or unprofessional.
risk_categories.recommended_action: Negotiate clear working hours before accepting.

risk_categories.name: Pay Mismatch for Scope/Experience
risk_categories.description: Offered compensation is significantly below market for the required skills or experience.
examples: $100 for a full iOS + IoT project
risk_categories.recommended_action: Negotiate or decline. Underpriced work often leads to scope creep.
